statement: A domestic corporation, and a foreign corporation that does business, employs capital, owns or leases property, maintains an office, or derives receipts from activity in New York State, must file and pay the Article 9-A franchise tax on general business corporations (return Form CT-3, or CT-3-A for a combined group), computed as the highest of the business income, business capital, and fixed dollar minimum bases plus any MTA surcharge; for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2024 and before January 1, 2027, deriving $1,283,000 or more of receipts from New York activity is itself sufficient nexus.
caveat: The deriving-receipts threshold is CPI-indexed and reviewed annually; corporate-partner, unitary-combination, and S-corporation rules change the analysis, and New York City imposes its own separate business corporation tax. The short-form CT-4 was retired with the 2015 corporate tax reform — the current return is CT-3. Verify thresholds and rates on the live pages for the tax year at hand. This repo does not compute the tax.
